PDF Reader: Documents Master is an all-in-one tool for PDF management and reading. Whether you need to view documents, batch delete PDF files, or rename them, it handles everything with ease.

Core Features  
- View Documents: Quickly open and read PDF documents with smooth,  performance.  
- Batch Delete: Select multiple PDFs at once and delete them in bulk to free up storage space.  
- Quick Search: Instantly locate files by typing keywords.

Who It’s For  
Whether you are a student, teacher, office worker, or anyone who handles documents daily, PDF Reader: Documents Master will be your go‑to document assistant. Download Documents Master now and enjoy hassle‑free document processing!
